title: Sacred Bell of Great King Seongdeok

place.label: Gyeongju National Museum
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

timeline.event: Completed under King Hyegong of Unified Silla

tiers.everyday: The Sacred Bell of Great King Seongdeok in Gyeongju, finished in 771, is Korea's largest bell at about 18.9 tonnes. It is also called the Emille Bell.
tiers.student: Korea Heritage Service: completed in 771, 3.75 m high, 2.27 m across, walls 11–25 cm, about 18.9 t, first hung at Bongdeoksa, with a sound tube on top typical of Korean bells. Gyeongju City gives 3.66 m (height conflict kept open).

model.label: Parametric profile scaled from the sourced diameter and height and wall thickness; the curve itself is a generic Western bell profile, not a scan.
